description: This PHP class 'CodingStandardCommands' provides command-line utilities for managing PHP code standards using tools like php-cs-fixer, including fixing code style issues, dry-run checks, and fixing only modified files. It is part of the SuiteCRM project's Robo task automation setup.
external_files: Paths.php (implied as it is used for project paths)

classes.name: CodingStandardCommands
classes.description: A Robo command class to automate PHP coding standard enforcement and checking.

methods.name: stylePHPCSFixer
methods.description: Automatically fixes PHP coding style issues with php-cs-fixer.

methods.name: stylePHPCSFixerDryRun
methods.description: Checks for coding standard issues without fixing them, using a dry-run.

methods.name: stylePHPCSFixerModified
methods.description: Fixes coding standards only in modified files by analyzing git diffs.
